note: Spent by T-2478: four or five Illinois Central tracks along the lake east of Prairie Avenue, a wavy water's edge right against them, and the railway's breakwater drawn offshore. No beach, park or walk between the tracks and the lake. Spent by T-3099: 1811 Prairie's house drawn one continuous body about 27 m deep (5.7-32.8 m from the street line, read along the lot's own 150 ft at 0.86 px a foot), as the 1911 sheet draws it, and its stable drawn crossed and marked '25' on the alley 38-46 m back. Only depths are read on that lot: the plate draws the house as wide as its lot.
